decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the equivalent automatic-wrap and right-column-containment behavior, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Automatic wrapping of overflowing text boxes does not change the independently defined behavior for clearing placeholder text when a field is activated.
The source overflow decision does not alter bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, spacing, or approved appearance.
Automatic word wrapping does not eliminate or modify the requirement that hard returns use appropriate spacing in continuous text.
The overflow-containment rule does not change the independently required support for ordinary Enter-based multiline input.
Wrapping text in Indstilling left-side boxes does not affect the Board Meeting rule preventing extra borders after Topic line insertion.
The source overflow behavior does not change the date selector's input method or document applicability.
Keeping the Indstilling right-hand column from being pushed outward does not necessarily change the separate Vejledning margin behavior around the pencil icon.
The source decision concerns text-box overflow during content growth and does not modify the established legacy-content migration workflow or its general stability standard.
The Indstilling text-box wrapping decision does not alter alignment among Item and Title, Topic, Proposal, and Start time in the Board Meeting template.
Text-box overflow containment has no effect on which theme colors are included or available for selection.
The source overflow decision does not change the requested walkthrough or explanation of how Master template tables function.
